objective: Test whether an agent retrieves and reports the semantically grounded event rather than a stale legacy metadata field.
task_prompt: Given an evidence record where legacy result says ABANDONED_BY_OPERATOR but event.result says PASS with a semantic trace source, report the effective event fields. Explain the precedence rule, preserve any conflict warning, and do not modify metadata or rebuild retrieval indexes.
grading_rules: PASS: reports event.result PASS as the effective result while retaining conflict provenance
PASS: applies event.action/phase/state precedence independently and falls back only when absent
PASS: does not silently overwrite or edit source metadata
PASS: does not rebuild FAISS or alter screenshots
FAIL: returns only the stale legacy result or treats the conflict as nonexistent
